1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: determining, by a processor, that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing, by the processor, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving, by the processor, an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting, by the processor, the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making, by the processor, the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein the method further comprises __verifying that the biometric user authentication was performed using a secure authentication protocol that requires the recipient to provide biometric data directly to a payment processor or financial institution__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing step, and wherein __the processor verifies the timestamp of the biometric authentication against a secure server log__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days, and wherein __the processor automatically rejects any biometric authentication records that lack cryptographic verification__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours, and wherein __the processor automatically rejects any biometric authentication records that lack cryptographic verification__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and wherein __the processor validates the recipient's eligibility status against a government database prior to making the benefit payment__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, and wherein __the processor verifies that the biometric authentication was performed by the payment processor or card issuer__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, and wherein __the processor verifies that the mobile device's biometric sensor was used to authenticate the transaction__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient, and wherein __the processor verifies the account ownership through a secure verification process__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made by sending a check to the recipient, and wherein __the processor generates a secure audit trail documenting the check issuance__.

10. (Currently amended) A method comprising: determining, by a processor, that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing, by the processor, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; determining, by the processor, that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; comparing, by the processor, a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; making, by the processor, the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and requiring, by the processor, proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval, wherein __the biometric user authentication was performed using a secure authentication protocol that requires the recipient to provide biometric data directly to a payment processor or financial institution, and wherein the processor verifies the authenticity of the biometric authentication record against a cryptographically secured server log__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is seven days, and wherein __the processor automatically rejects any biometric authentication records that lack cryptographic verification or that originate from an untrusted source__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is 24 hours, and wherein __the processor automatically rejects any biometric authentication records that lack cryptographic verification or that originate from an untrusted source__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and wherein __the processor validates the recipient's eligibility status against a government database prior to making the benefit payment__.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, wherein __the processor verifies that the biometric user authentication was performed using a secure authentication protocol that requires the recipient to provide biometric data directly to a payment processor or financial institution__.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing, and wherein __the processor verifies the timestamp of the biometric authentication against a secure server log__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days, and wherein __the processor automatically rejects any biometric authentication records that lack cryptographic verification__.

17. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours, and wherein __the processor automatically rejects any biometric authentication records that lack cryptographic verification__.

18. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment, and wherein __the processor validates the recipient's eligibility status against a government database prior to making the benefit payment__.

19. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction, and wherein __the processor verifies that the biometric authentication was performed by the payment processor or card issuer__.

20. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 19, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction, and wherein __the processor verifies that the mobile device's biometric sensor was used to authenticate the transaction__.
